Name: Craftable Rings
Author: UncleArya
Description:
[size=3]I have been playing mostly on Steam Deck since 1.6 released and the one downside is how dark and impossible it is to see at night time in game without a glow ring.

[b]How to obtain recipes:[/b]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Small Glow Ring - Combat Level 1[/size]
[*][size=3]Small Magnet Ring - Mining Level 1[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Since both skills should be achievable very early on, the crafting ingredients are relatively simple and should also be obtainable by the time you level up.

[b]Compatibilities[/b]

This mod would likely go really well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10669]Ring Overhaul[/url], as that wonderful mod adds upgrade recipes for both rings once you reach Mining Level 4. I strongly recommend using that mod if you also use this one.

Since this mod only requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and doesn't change the way the rings work, it shouldn't have any incompatibilities.
